34	def source_fingerprint() -> str:
35	    digest = hashlib.sha256()
36	    tracked_suffixes = {".c", ".cc", ".cpp", ".h", ".hpp"}
37	    paths = [
38	        path
39	        for path in SOURCE.rglob("*")
40	        if path.is_file()
41	        and (path.suffix.lower() in tracked_suffixes or path.name.startswith("Makefile"))
42	    ]

44	        digest.update(str(path.relative_to(SOURCE)).encode("utf-8"))
45	        digest.update(b"\0")
46	        digest.update(path.read_bytes())
47	        digest.update(b"\0")
48	    return digest.hexdigest()
